note: Tier 1. A plays a land from a nine-card hand in the precombat main phase of turn 3; with no creatures and no further decision the turn runs to the cleanup step, where A holds eight cards against a maximum hand size of seven and must discard one (402.2, 514.1). The discard is a question without a null answer (spec 5.6). After it nothing happens in the cleanup step (514.2, 514.3a) and the record ends at B's first priority of turn 4, in the upkeep (502.4, 503.1), before B's draw. The nine-card hand on turn 3 is stipulated by the position (spec 2.4), not reached by ordinary play.
